BiblicalUsage: Daniel watches times and kings change hands: the Chaldeans say no man can change the time, Daniel answers that God changes the times and the seasons, and Ezra records the king's warning that no one shall alter his word.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that men change laws and times, but only God changes them to any lasting purpose.
